prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished primary logo lockup for AMPVE, an approachable ambitious product bringing applications and AI to people's existing devices, spanning tiny boards, displays, computers and future objects. This is a NEW friendly identity, not an industrial IoT management brand. Asset: horizontal logo with a unique simple geometric orange symbol followed by the exact uppercase word "AMPVE" in distinctive softly rounded heavy graphite sans serif lettering. Symbol: an open arch formed by two rounded upward legs, with a small floating rounded square nestled just above its opening, suggesting an application finding a home; strong simple silhouette, only a few shapes. Warm ember orange #E7653D and graphite #252823. Quiet confident playful precision, refined Swiss graphic design with human warmth. Flat solid colors, no shading, no mockup, no bevel, no gradient, no extra labels, no tagline. Wide horizontal composition, generous clear space, mark and word optically balanced. Truly transparent background with alpha, not checkerboard painted into the image. Crisp high resolution suitable as a raster brand asset. Spell A M P V E exactly.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop web application screenshot for AMPVE. Input image is a BRAND STYLE REFERENCE only; faithfully reuse its orange arch-and-square symbol and AMPVE wordmark. New product positioning: a friendly home for apps and AI across your everyday devices, not an industrial device platform. Design an outstanding believable web UI, full canvas straight-on screenshot 16:10 wide, no browser frame or physical monitor. Warm ivory #F7F5EE background, graphite text #252823, warm orange #E7653D primary actions, pale sage panels, thin soft borders, generous whitespace, restrained rounded corners, editorial typography. Slim left sidebar with brand, navigation exact text "Home", "My devices", "Explore apps", "Connections", "Settings"; footer avatar "Lucas" and "Personal workspace". Main heading "Make room for more." subheading "Your devices. New possibilities." Top-right orange button "+ Add a device". A large warm hero card shows a beautifully rendered friendly small screen companion with orange eyes and adjacent copy "Meet your first companion" and button "Set up Companion". Below heading "Your space", one actual device card "Desk companion", "Waveshare P4", subtle green "Online", app "Companion", small action "Open". Adjacent tasteful outlined empty card "A new home for your next idea" and "Add a device". At bottom a horizontal section "Explore what comes next" contains two small softly colored illustrations labeled "Ambient display" and "Everyday automations", both explicitly marked "Coming later". All text readable and spelled correctly. Keep scope honest: one connected P4 only, future device illustrations not presented as existing fleet. No charts, uptime KPIs, racks, circuitry overload, terminal logs, AI glitter, purple gradients, generic robot head logo, watermark. Cohesive refined product design with real layout hierarchy.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a second high fidelity AMPVE desktop web UI screenshot, wide 16:10. Reference 1 is the logo identity; reference 2 is the established UI style and spacing to match. Create the onboarding screen, a calm approachable product wizard, no marketing collage. Warm ivory background, graphite typography, orange primary button, pale sage success indicators. Left sidebar uses AMPVE logo and navigation Home / My devices / Explore apps / Connections / Settings, with My devices highlighted. Main top breadcrumb "My devices / Add a device". Heading "A new beginning for your device." Three horizontal steps "1 Connect" (completed), "2 Make it yours" (active), "3 Start something". Main content two columns: left a clean studio illustration of a landscape seven inch development screen on a discreet stand connected to a laptop by a clearly visible USB cable; the screen has two simple orange rounded eyes. Below small labels "Waveshare P4 Touch LCD 7B" and green pill "Connected". Right a large white settings panel heading "Meet your companion", fields "Device name" with value "Desk companion"; "Application" with value "AMPVE Companion"; "AI connection" with dropdown value "Gemini · Personal key" and subtle link "Manage connections"; "Personality" with value "Curious, warm, and concise". At bottom concise note "Your API key stays on your server." Orange button "Activate Companion", secondary "Back". Below wizard small neutral status "Compatible firmware installed". No actual secrets, no fake claim of all hardware compatibility. Perfect readable short English copy, realistic UI components, large generous whitespace, subtle depth only for device illustration, no technical dashboards, no purple, no gradients, no extra promotional copy. Match supplied logo without changing its geometry.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create the main GitHub README brand banner for AMPVE, very wide horizontal 3:1, high resolution. Reference image is the exact logo identity to reuse, orange symbol plus graphite AMPVE wordmark. Product idea: bring useful apps and AI to the devices around you, broad open possibility and human friendliness. Warm ivory #F7F5EE studio background, subtle sage accents and orange #E7653D. Left half is clean graphic typography with the supplied AMPVE logo, large headline EXACTLY "Your devices." on first line and "New possibilities." on second line. Small supporting line EXACTLY "Bring apps and AI into your world." Right half contains a sophisticated tactile 3D still life of different generic everyday computing shapes: a landscape desk display with two tiny orange friendly eyes, a small rounded mini-computer with a couple of discreet ports, a compact ambient circular display showing a sun icon, and a few floating rounded app tiles with simple chat bubble, waveform, and sun pictograms. A delicate orange ribbon curves through the composition suggesting ideas becoming useful across objects. Editorial product photography meets restrained playful 3D design, warm matte ceramic and anodized graphite, soft contact shadows, natural studio light. Do not imply hardware is manufactured by AMPVE: no logo printed on objects. The AMPVE logo appears only in the left typography area. Broad future-facing conceptual artwork, not a compatibility advertisement. No extra text, no industrial board schematics, no wires everywhere, no cyberpunk, no purple, no dramatic glows, no watermark. Leave generous margins and make all text readable at GitHub README size.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone reusable frontend hero illustration for AMPVE. Reference image is a visual style reference: match its warm matte materials, orange and sage palette, softly rounded objects and friendly computing theme, but REMOVE ALL typography, brand words and background scene. Compose an isolated compact family of generic devices: a graphite landscape display on a small ivory stand with two subtle orange friendly eyes; a low ivory mini-computer with discreet ports; a round cream ambient display showing a simple orange sun. Three small rounded app tiles, chat bubble, waveform, sun, float lightly around the objects; a single thin flowing orange ribbon links them in a soft visual arc. Elegant tactile 3D render with clear silhouettes, premium miniature industrial design, believable perspective, soft studio lighting, restrained warm shadows. Slight three-quarter view, objects fully inside frame, generous clean margins. NO surface or room, NO plants, NO cups, NO writing, NO logos, NO watermark, NO background rectangle. Truly transparent alpha background, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Landscape 3:2 composition. This is conceptual future-facing art for software bringing applications and AI to everyday hardware, not a real hardware product lineup.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied illustration. Preserve the devices, floating tiles, orange connecting ribbon, composition, materials, colors and lighting exactly. Remove the entire visible gray-and-white grid background, including the background visible between objects and through open spaces. Replace it with actual transparent PNG alpha, every background pixel alpha zero. Do not draw a new backdrop, do not draw a transparency grid. The final file must be an isolated cutout with genuinely empty transparent surroundings, clean antialiased object edges. No text, no new elements.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep the provided device illustration and its composition. Replace the gray checkerboard background completely with a seamless flat warm ivory background, solid hex #F7F5EE across the canvas. No grid, no pattern, no texture, no room or floor. Preserve all devices, orange ribbon and floating app tiles. Very soft contact shadows only directly underneath the objects. Remove the grid visible between every object and around every edge. This final image is an opaque warm-ivory frontend illustration, not a transparency preview. No words or logos.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a square AMPVE brand avatar/app icon based on the supplied exact primary logo. Extract and faithfully reproduce only the orange symbol: two separated thick curved upright legs with rounded caps and a small separate rounded square centered above the open arch. No letters. Place this orange mark centered on a solid warm ivory #F7F5EE square canvas, symbol occupying 60 percent width with generous even padding. Flat graphic solid fills, crisp clean edges, no gradient, no lighting, no texture, no shadows, no mockup, no decorative frame, no text. Preserve the unique symbol geometry from reference. This is the AMPVE platform brand avatar, not a robot face.

Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished standalone square app catalog icon for "AMPVE Companion", but include NO TEXT. This is an APPLICATION icon distinct from AMPVE's brand mark. A centered gently rounded graphite square tile on a solid warm ivory background. Inside tile just two thick orange upward-curved smiling closed eyes, friendly calm expression, extremely simple and legible at small scale. Tiny subtle rounded orange mouth optional only if it improves balance. Soft tactile ceramic-like tile with very restrained edge highlight and soft short contact shadow. Orange #E7653D, graphite #252823, ivory #F7F5EE. Straight-on view, square composition, 16 percent safe margin around tile. No robot body, no antennas, no brand logo, no gradients in the eyes, no words, no watermark, no extra decorative objects. Friendly companion identity consistent with the orange-eyed screens in reference.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a beautiful high fidelity public landing page design for AMPVE, wide desktop screenshot 16:10, no browser frame. Image 1 is exact AMPVE logo reference; image 2 is reference for the friendly tactile device hero illustration to incorporate. Product: bring applications and AI to the devices you already own. Not a device management dashboard. Layout: refined slim top navigation with logo left and text links "Discover", "How it works", "GitHub", right small "Sign in" and orange "Get started". Big airy hero left: small pill "A new life for your devices"; headline EXACTLY "Your devices." then "New possibilities." large bold rounded graphite sans serif, second line warm orange. Supporting text EXACTLY "Bring apps and AI into your world." Then solid deep orange button "Bring a device" and outline button "Explore the idea". Under buttons tiny clear status "Starting with Waveshare P4. More devices ahead." Hero right reuse the supplied devices and app tiles illustration, scaled beautifully with plenty of space. Background warm ivory #F7F5EE, typography graphite #252823, orange accents #E7653D, pale sage. Below hero one editorial section heading "From something you own to something you love." and three clean short numbered steps across the page, with small elegant icons: "01 Connect a device" / "02 Find its next purpose" / "03 Make it yours". Short supporting line under each respectively "Start with supported hardware." / "Choose an app to bring it to life." / "Your settings. Your AI connection." Bottom hint of next section "One companion. A world of possibilities." with small status pill "First app". Clear typographic hierarchy, intentional asymmetry, substantial whitespace, understated refined visual design, warm and inviting. No invented user counts, testimonials, reviews, pricing, promises of universal compatibility, charts, server jargon, glitter or watermark. All text readable.
